questions.answer: No; meaningful opportunities and access matter.
Different people may need different ways to meet the same objective.

questions.prompt: Must everyone speak to be included?
questions.answer: No; participation can occur through other formats or be declined.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Identifies barriers and verifies equivalent participation routes, consent and responsibility for unresolved access issues.
scoring.transfer: Complete the meeting facilitation capstone with roles, conformity checks, a decision-oriented agenda and an inclusion audit. Include a remote or written equivalent, an unresolved barrier, responsible owner and a revised process after feedback.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
